title: The number, made of the work
label: Thousands of grains, each one a batch of four events, breathe as a dust ring, pour into the digits of the week's total, then melt into one bar per source with its exact count, and drift back into the ring.
heading:
The number,
made of the work.
sub: Every grain is four real events. Watch them add up, then sort by where they came from.
